title: Mahak makar a back
html_source: A Masonic invocation of good luck, according to the annotation in the Penguin 20c. Classics Annotated Students' Edition. See also this article about Masonic symbols and phrases used in this chapter.

anchor.prefix: ion, bucket in my hand. Cheerio, boys. (He turns to his subjects.) We have come 1922#548here to witness a clean straight fight and we heartily wish both men the best of good luck.

1961#590

(He shakes hands with Private Carr, Private Compton, Stephen, Bloom and Lynch. General applause. Edward the Seventh lifts his bucket graciously in acknowledgment.)
